name: NHL Live Ice
author: ant456
description: An arcade-style NHL show with three modes: live games (an arena scoreboard with an LED-dot clock and period, shots on goal, a power-play lamp and your own logo, period scores, a flame on runs of unanswered goals, player cards with ESPN headshots and rarity frames, and a burst for every goal), recently finished games (final score plus the same stat cards), and upcoming games (matchup, records, puck drop and line). Pick favorite teams and switch on the favorites lock to show only their games in every mode. ESPN's public scoreboard, no API key.

versions.notes: Optional Govee light effects in the scoring team's colours (LAN or Home Assistant): burst, flash, pulse, chase, strobe, fireworks and glow, with the lights restored afterwards.

Changed: the ice rink is replaced by an arena scoreboard -- red LED-dot game clock, amber period, shots on goal for each team and a logo box in the middle, with a blinking gold border during a power play. New setting scoreboard_logo (or drop a logo.png in the plugin folder) puts your own logo in the box; the NHL shield is the default.

First release. Live, recent and upcoming NHL games in the Fantasy Blitz arcade style: ice rink with a moving puck, period scores, shots on goal, power-play marker, CLUTCH warning, flame on three unanswered goals, player cards (goals, assists, points, goalie saves) with rarity frames and a hat-trick badge, and a burst for every goal (go-ahead, equalizer, overtime winner). Favorites lock, exclude list and spoiler delay.

api_requirements.name: ESPN API
api_requirements.description: ESPN's public NHL scoreboard (scores, period and clock, quarter scores, records, spread and per-team leaders) and ESPN player headshots. One request per day asked for (yesterday, today, tomorrow). No API key.
